title: WinDirStat
design_implication: WinDirStat is already open source; use it as a comparator, not a proprietary straw man.

title: Czkawka source
design_implication: Reference an existing Rust duplicate-finding project; do not assume its benchmarks transfer to this prototype.

title: System Informer source
design_implication: Established process-inspection comparator; do not claim an equivalent Windows internals surface.

title: Everything documentation
design_implication: Filename indexing and a storage adviser solve different problems. Compare index freshness and footprint separately.

title: Microsoft: change journals
design_implication: Incremental NTFS change tracking can avoid repeated full enumeration.

title: Microsoft: change journal records
design_implication: Records can be discarded or coalesced and cannot reconstruct file contents for undo.

title: Microsoft: ReadDirectoryChangesW
design_implication: Zero bytes after buffer overflow requires re-enumeration, not a clean-index assertion.

title: Microsoft: FILE_ID_INFO
design_implication: Handle-derived volume and file identifiers are a stronger basis than path strings. Probe actual platform support.

title: Microsoft: reparse points
design_implication: A directory entry can redirect access; path-prefix checks alone are not a sufficient execution boundary.

title: Microsoft: hard links and junctions
design_implication: Directory entries and underlying file objects are not one-to-one.

title: Microsoft: cloud placeholder attributes
design_implication: Treat cloud placeholders as a separate capability; inspection must not silently hydrate them.

title: Microsoft: fsutil behavior
design_implication: Last-access behavior is configurable; timestamps do not establish reliable usage history.

title: Microsoft: CopyFile2
design_implication: Use a supported copy primitive behind a verified transaction, not a promise of cross-volume atomic moves.

title: Microsoft: known folders
design_implication: Resolve supported Windows known folders instead of hardcoding an English Desktop path.

title: Microsoft: shell links
design_implication: Shortcuts have structured state; a filename replacement is not complete shortcut management.

title: Microsoft: VSS overview
design_implication: Snapshot consistency and independent backup retention are distinct responsibilities.

title: Microsoft: job objects
design_implication: Jobs can manage related processes and limits. Begin with workloads launched by Loomward.

title: Microsoft: SetProcessInformation
design_implication: Windows exposes process policy controls including power and memory priority; support and rights require probing.

title: Microsoft: working set sizing
design_implication: Working-set manipulation is not equivalent to safely reducing committed application memory.

title: Microsoft: working set
design_implication: Resident physical pages are one memory view, not the entire process-memory story.

title: Microsoft: Win32_Product
design_implication: Avoid inventory that triggers MSI consistency/repair side effects.

title: SQLite WAL
design_implication: Keep the active catalogue local and account for WAL/checkpoint behavior; do not place it on a network share.

title: Tauri security
design_implication: Separate frontend trust from native powers. A Tauri label alone is not a security guarantee.

title: Tauri capabilities
design_implication: Use explicit per-window capabilities rather than broad shell/filesystem grants.

title: Tauri prerequisites
design_implication: Windows development requires its native toolchain and WebView2-related prerequisites.

title: restic backup documentation
design_implication: Candidate backup-provider integration; record actual provider results rather than infer protection.

title: restic repository operations
design_implication: Repository checks and restore tests belong in protection health, separate from a successful backup invocation.

title: LM Studio structured output
design_implication: JSON-schema-constrained local teacher output is possible; still validate independently.

title: LM Studio TTL and eviction
design_implication: Model lifecycle controls can reduce idle model residency; do not unload a shared session blindly.

title: Snorkel paper
design_implication: Weak supervision is a useful conceptual foundation for noisy teacher labels, not proof of their correctness.

title: Guo et al.: calibration
design_implication: Predictive confidence requires evaluation/calibration. Safety authority remains a separate question.

title: sysinfo 0.33.1 documentation
design_implication: A possible portable native telemetry adapter; refresh/delta semantics and missing support must be explicit.
